pause.speaker: Lolo Berto
pause.line: Nakabalik ka. Umupo ka. May kape doon, kung mainit pa.
pause.line_en: You came back. Sit. There's coffee if it's still warm.

look_outside.speaker: Lolo Berto
look_outside.line: Tinitingnan ko ang hardin. Minsan... pakiramdam ko may hinihintay ako doon. Alam mo na — ganyan ang matanda. Ang isip, nananatili sa isang lugar kahit umaalis na ang katawan.
look_outside.line_en: I'm watching the garden. Sometimes... I feel like I'm waiting for someone there. You know how old people are. The mind stays in one place even when the body leaves.

ask_choice.speaker: Apo
ask_choice.line_en: Lolo, why are you like this?

choices.text_en: You used to be the funniest of us.
Are you really waiting for someone?

choices.text: May problema ba ninyo ni Lola?
choices.text_en: Is something wrong with you and Lola?

funny.speaker: Lolo Berto
funny.line: Oo, dati. Marami akong kuwento noong bata ka pa. Alam mo bakit tumigil ako? Dahil ang mga kuwento, pumupunta sa isang lugar. At iyong isang lugar na 'yon, hindi na ako puwede.
funny.line_en: Yes, once. I had so many stories when you were small. You know why I stopped? Stories lead to a place. And that place — I'm no longer allowed in it.

waiting.speaker: Lolo Berto
waiting.line: Hindi mahalaga sino. Ang mahalaga, naghihintay pa rin. Ganun minsan ang katandaan — tinuturuan tayong tumingin sa labas kahit alam natin na walang lalabas.
waiting.line_en: It doesn't matter who. What matters is that I'm still waiting. That's old age sometimes — it teaches you to look outside even when you know no one will come out.

lola.speaker: Lolo Berto
lola.line: Si Lola mo? Mahal na mahal ko si Lola mo. Pero may mga gabi na hindi kami nagkakausap. Hindi dahil galit — dahil pareho kaming walang masabi.
lola.line_en: Your Lola? I love your Lola. But there are nights when we don't speak. Not out of anger — because we both have nothing to say.

deflect.speaker: Lolo Berto
deflect.line: Pumasok ka na, apo. Mamaya kakausapin kita ulit. Matagal akong hindi nagsalita, kaya marami akong dapat iayos sa salita.
deflect.line_en: Go inside, apo. We'll talk again later. I've been quiet a long time — I need to put my words back together.

end.speaker: Lolo Berto
end.line:
Isa pa, apo. Kung may maririnig kang kalampag sa gabi — footsteps, buksan ng pinto, tinig ng bata — 'wag mong tingnan.

'Wag mong isagot.
end.line_en:
One more thing, apo. If you hear a sound tonight — footsteps, a door opening, a child's voice — don't look.

Don't answer.
